site_description: Indie developer focused on AI tools, product prototypes, and shippable web experiences.
hero_title: Building thoughtful tools, one small idea at a time.
hero_subtitle: I turn fuzzy product ideas into working prototypes, and polish AI workflows, open-source tools, and front-end experiences until they are ready to show, test, and ship.
section_about_title_secondary: You can also call me yuhan
about_fallback_bio: I'm an indie developer who turns real problems into clear, usable, demo-ready products. I often work around AI tooling, prompt management, automation workflows, and creative coding, and I open-source the parts worth reusing.
about_work_note: I work mostly with TypeScript, React, and Postgres, and can move from product framing to interface, data model, launch, and validation. Bring a product idea, growth problem, internal tool, or developer-community collaboration.
section_collaboration_title: I fit best where an early idea needs to become real quickly.
section_collaboration_subtitle: The site keeps its personal texture, but makes the working surface clearer: I help turn promising ideas into something people can see, try, and improve.
collaboration_item_product_body: Shape a rough brief into flows, interface, and a working version that can test whether users actually care.
collaboration_item_ai_body: Build lightweight tools around prompts, model calls, knowledge bases, automation, and admin surfaces that teams will use daily.
collaboration_item_partner_body: A good fit for brands, communities, open-source projects, content teams, or founders with a clear scene and room to experiment.
collaboration_note: If you already have users, distribution, data, domain insight, or a concrete scene to validate, I can help make it discussable and testable.
projects_page_description: A live-curated list of open-source projects. Filter by language, search by name or topic, and jump to a demo when one is available.
projects_preview_empty: No projects are published yet. Sync from the admin panel when you're ready to show them.
section_travel_description: Live snapshots from places I've stayed, wandered through, and kept thinking about afterward.
travel_empty: No travel photo walls are published yet.
blog_page_description: Short essays on building things, prompt engineering, and the occasional side quest.
section_contact_title: Send the project, resource, or collaboration lead.
section_contact_subtitle: Share the goal, timeline, and what you already have. I usually reply within a day or two.
contact_direct_body: One email is enough. A product sketch, brief, repository, audience data, or any context that helps me judge the fit is even better.
